# Review - PR 420 @ 38d87ee52dae7b57e7c904eabe383ec6b8a91636

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: 7c44a85bddf8c96ad5aed58b4df9714b8187f2a8. A 357-line, five-file additive change that proves the two point-marginal squared-distance bounds for a joint point witness, converts the point self-consistency estimate to the defect convention, and transports all three from uniform point pairs to the point coordinates of two independent line-point samples.

## Findings

- [ ] F1 (code; changes) MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/PointSelfConsistency.lean:31 - the private helper `avgOver_mix_noFinite` repeats `MIPStarRE.QPBT.avgOver_mix` (MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/RestrictedAverage.lean:34) verbatim: same namespace, same sibling directory, same `[DecidableEq α]`-only hypotheses, and a character-identical proof. The `noFinite` suffix guards only against `WinImplications.avgOver_mix`, which is the `[Finite X]` variant; the unrestricted one already exists. AGENTS.md:426 allows a file-local helper only when it genuinely reduces duplication. Fix: import `MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Lines.RestrictedAverage` (acyclic - it pulls in only `Lines.RestrictedMixture`, itself importing `Combining.Defs`, and `Combining.Witnesses`, none of which reaches this new file) and use `avgOver_mix` at line 90, deleting lines 31-56.
- [ ] F2 (prose; changes) MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points.lean:66 - the docstring of `postprocess_snd_effect` says the identity "is `eq:qld-qxz-close-to-point-2`, paper ...:933-935", but both halves are wrong. `eq:qld-qxz-close-to-point-2` sits at `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:928-930` and is the approximation "Q^{x,z}_b approx_{deltaQ} M^{(Point,Z),z}_b"; lines 933-935 are the `\begin{gather}` of line-versus-point relations drawn from `lem:qld-comm-line-cons`, a different statement. The lemma proved here is the definitional marginal sum, not either of those. Fix: mirror the correct sibling wording at Points.lean:48-51 - "the definition preceding `eq:qld-qxz-close-to-point-2`, paper ...:928-930".
- [ ] F3 (prose; changes) MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/WitnessMarginals.lean:68 - `marginal_Z_distance_le` cites "`eq:qld-qxz-close-to-point-2`, paper lines 933--935"; the equation is at lines 928-930, and 933-935 belong to `lem:qld-comm-line-cons`. The companion ranges are also off: `eq:qld-qxz-close-to-point` and its calculation occupy lines 914-926, not the "917-932" given at WitnessMarginals.lean:29 and Points.lean:51, and the module range "917-935" at WitnessMarginals.lean:13 should end at 930. AGENTS.md:294 requires the docstring to cite the paper passage by label or line range; a range that lands on a different lemma defeats the check. Fix: replace the four ranges with 914-926 (`eq:qld-qxz-close-to-point`), 928-930 (`eq:qld-qxz-close-to-point-2`) and 914-930 (module).

## Review

Base: PR 420 targets `issue-406-witness-marginal-distance`, but `git merge-base github/issue-406-witness-marginal-distance 38d87ee5` is `13409f63`, identical to the merge base with `github/main`, so the base-relative and main-relative diffs coincide; I reviewed that single 357-line diff. The worktree HEAD equals the published head. There are no earlier marked reviews on this PR, so no prior finding needed re-checking.

Faithfulness. `marginal_X_distance_le` is `eq:qld-qxz-close-to-point`: it applies `norm_marginal_sub_sq_le` (MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/MarginalContraction.lean:33) to `points.consistent_ZX`, and that field compares Q with `M^{(Point,Z),z}_b * M^{(Point,X),x}_a` (Witnesses.lean:87-95), which is exactly the ordered product the paper introduces at tex:923 and bounds at tex:924. The Z lemma is the mirror image with `consistent_XZ`. The constant `4 * deltaQ` comes from `norm_marginal_sub_sq_le` and is an honest reading of the paper's `O(delta)` conclusion at tex:925; the docstrings say the supplied witness error is retained rather than claiming the source's `deltaQ`. `self_consistency_defect_le` goes through `consistencyDefect_le_opFamilyDistSq_of_projective` (Games/DistanceTheorems/Calculus.lean:63), which is a genuine inequality (`opFamilyDistSq = 2 * consistencyDefect`), so `eq:qld-q-self-cons` is not weakened. The two `linePoint` transports are equalities, not estimates: `avgOver_prod_linePointDist_points` rewrites the product law to the uniform pair law using the point marginals of `aLinePointDist`/`dLinePointDist` (Test/LowDegreeGameTheorems.lean:118,167), matching the sampling described at tex:931. `marginal_X_linePoint_distance_le` compares against `pointMeasExp .X sample.1.2`, i.e. the point measurement, and its docstring says plainly that no line comparison is assumed - it is the first step toward `eq:pasting-q1` (tex:938-940), not that equation. Q is indexed `(sample.1.2, sample.2.2)`, the point of the X sample and the point of the Z sample, as the source requires.

Integrity and hygiene. `rg -n "sorry|admit|axiom|native_decide"` over the four touched Lean files returns nothing; no statement is conditioned on a bridge, residual or wrapper hypothesis, and every new declaration is universally quantified over an arbitrary `CombinedPointsWitness`, so nothing is vacuous. `lake env lean` on `Lines/PointMarginalTransport.lean` and `Points/WitnessMarginals.lean` both exit 0 with no diagnostics. The two `set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in` uses are local and carry a stated reason. Every new declaration has a docstring; file lengths are 345/104/151/72 lines. Commit subjects follow `type(scope): short description` and the PR body has Motivation, Description and Testing. CI at the exact head: all ten gating contexts are green (`local-ci/summary` "all gating steps passed"); the only failing context is `local-review/summary`, which records that the code-review lane exited without a review - the reason this review exists.

Prose is in scope only through Lean documentation; no blueprint TeX, paper-gap note or audit file is touched, so there is no `\lean`/`\leanok`/`\uses` tag to check. The docstring prose is otherwise accurate and free of Lean jargon; F2 and F3 are the locator defects.

Not checked: the internals of `norm_marginal_sub_sq_le`, `consistencyDefect_le_opFamilyDistSq_of_projective` and the `aLinePointDist`/`dLinePointDist` marginal lemmas (all pre-existing on main and unmodified here); the blueprint node these declarations will eventually be linked from; and I ran no full `lake build`, relying on the green exact-head `local-ci/build`.

A note beyond the findings, not blocking: `postprocess_fst_effect` and `postprocess_snd_effect` hold for any measurement with a product outcome type and use neither `S` nor `deltaQ`; stating them once as `Measurement` lemmas next to `Quantum/Measurement.lean:136` would make them reusable, per the modularity item of docs/CONTRIBUTING.md section 5.

VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED (code=CHANGES_REQUESTED, prose=CHANGES_REQUESTED)
